title: Fishtume
description: Fishtume is a 3D character project created in 2024 and recognised as a winner by The Rookies.

I’m reminded of my childhood, dressing up as animals—lions and tigers, always mammals. But I never saw a fish costume. That gap sparked an idea. While a real-life fish costume could be tricky, I saw Meetmat’s shape and helmet-like head as the perfect base for a fish-inspired hoodie, complete with textured details.
